excerpt: Inflation has varied across U.S. states, with families spending an average of $700 more due to inflation under Trump. The highest inflation increase was in Hawaii, while Texas had the lowest. The data reflects average household consumption from November 2025.

The Debt Dashboard features the Monthly Debt Update and Congressman David Schweikert's Daily Debt Monitor. See the current state of the national debt and how it has changed over time. The Monthly Employment Update features national- and state-level changes in nonfarm payrolls, labor force participation rates, and more. The Monthly Expenditures Update details changes in consumption expenditures and personal income, including PCE price index inflation. ### Inflation Update. The Monthly Inflation Update covers changes in the Consumer Price Index and real earnings over time. The Medicare Affordability Tracker examines the impact of overpayments to Medicare Advantage on premiums for all enrollees in Medicare Part B. The Monthly Trade Update covers the latest data on international trade in goods and services, including exports and imports by country and good and average applied duty rates. ### State Inflation Tracker. The State Inflation Tracker illustrates the impact of inflation on Americans in all 50 states and DC.
